title: Getting more out of the Claude Platform
description: Cut cost, manage context, boost intelligence. In this session, we'll show you how to put our latest platform capabilities to work. Through live demos you'll see what great prompt caching looks like, learn to keep context lean for long-running agents with tool search, programmatic tool calling, and compaction, and use the advisor strategy for a cost-effective intelligence boost.

segments.heading: Architectural Overview and System Objectives in Getting more out of the Claude Platform
segments.text: Cut cost, manage context, boost intelligence. In this session, we'll show you how to put our latest platform capabilities to work. Through live demos you'll see what great prompt caching looks like, learn to keep context lean for long-running agents with tool search, programmatic tool calling, and compaction, and use the advisor strategy for a cost-effective intelligence boost. The session details foundational design principles, execution patterns, and operational integration requirements within the AI Agents, Prompt Engineering domain.

segments.heading: Technical Capabilities, Tooling Integration, and Protocols
segments.text: Speakers analyze technical capabilities across Claude. The architecture highlights reliable agent tool use, context window optimization, protocol standards, and seamless workflow interoperability.

segments.heading: Production Deployment, Verification, and Best Practices
segments.text: Production readiness demands robust evaluation harnesses, state validation, and error-handling loops. Teams implement systematic monitoring and guardrails to ensure reliability across repeated executions.

segments.heading: Organizational Impact, Scalability, and Industry Outlook
segments.text: Deploying agentic systems transforms developer and team workflows by automating high-friction tasks. Organizations scale safely by pairing automated tool orchestration with structured human review.
